The current curated source pair therefore has a caller/callee command-ABI mismatch.

finding.source_level_conclusion: For the exact pinned curated source pair, automatic fallback-start is not an executable caller-to-callee contract as written. A normal argparse dispatch against this exact harness_aider.py should fail before model/provider execution.
